name: Upsolve AI
description:
Upsolve AI brings production-ready analytics intelligence into Claude. Connect your SQL-based data warehouse and ask any data question in plain English. Claude calls Upsolve’s analytics agent, which generates SQL, runs the query against your data sources, and returns AI-powered insights, interactive charts, and aggregated data tables rendered directly inside your conversation.

Unlike generic text-to-SQL tools, Upsolve encodes your team’s institutional knowledge: KPI definitions, validated SQL patterns, and business logic rules, so every answer is accurate and trustworthy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Upsolve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upsolve AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.upsolve.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upsolve AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upsolve AI provides these MCP tools: analyze_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upsolve AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Upsolve AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Upsolve AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upsolve AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Upsolve AI is developed by Upsolve AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
